title: Pink Glass Shelf With Towel Bar, 16-Inch Wall-Mounted, Solid Brass Rail, 3/8-In Tempered Glass, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf with towel bar for bathroom storage, 16 inches / 16-inch / 16 in wall mount installation in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. This wall-mounted glass shelf (bathroom shelf, wall shelf) combines a shelf and towel bar/towel holder for toiletries and towels in one space-saving design. Made with 3/8-in thick tempered glass (0.38 in) and solid brass hardware with a solid brass gallery rail to help keep items secure. Dimensions: 16 in length x 5 in projection (depth) x 12 in height; weight capacity 4 lb. Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look; mounting uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Traditional style that fits transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware schemes, including matching Waverly Place collection pieces and grooved bathroom hardware looks. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; assembly required: no. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Waverly Place collection.
